nominalBodyLength.evidence: Scale target consistent with supplied manufacturer-page screenshot. Screenshot is model year 2026, not a chassis-specific 2023 source; front and rear overhangs are scaled to this nominal envelope while preserving axle spacing.

widthWithMirrors.evidence: Scale target from the 2026 reference screenshot, not chassis-specific verification.

bodyWidthWithoutMirrors.evidence: Bare cargo-shell proportion estimate; replaces the former 82-inch camper-envelope assumption.

roofToGround.evidence: Current model ground plane follows the photo-estimated hub position and nominal tire radius. This is not a measured overall vehicle height; rack, suspension load and terrain are unverified.

lengthWithCarrier.evidence: Digital combined envelope from nominal shell front to modeled rear tie-down tube. Receiver location and insertion depth are unmeasured; not an installed-vehicle measurement.

registration: Owner 60 × 122-inch planning rectangle retains body origin [0,26,0]. Rear rail ends are photo-estimated at body Y149 (planning Y123), rear beam at body Y147. The owner-reported 130-inch first/last-center span remains unregistered; illustrated main-beam span121 is not a corrected measurement. Saved equipment coordinates and geometry are unchanged.
scope: Exterior with sleeping flares, side/rear glazing, running gear, hood lip, roof rack/light bar, driver-side Owl ladder, installed A/C, driver-side Starlink, four solar panels, two front-crossbar antennas, Maxxair fan, bagged snowboard and two rear clamp carriers, receiver, HAUL-MASTER 57720 carrier and 2021 KTM 350 SX-F. Awning, separate rear-door steps, spare carrier and interior remain deferred in the installed reference; independently saved planning layouts may include them.
uncertainty: No dimensional tolerance established. All unmeasured contours, seams, glazing, tires, lamps and stance are estimates. Do not derive mounting positions or usable clearance from shell surfaces.
license: Original model geometry and code: MIT. Supplied reference imagery and manufacturer trademarks are not relicensed.

bodyPaint.description: Blue-gray with an additional small blue shift at owner request
bodyPaint.evidence: Compared actual driver/passenger WebGL views with owner photographs. Appearance estimate under studio lighting, not a calibrated color or factory paint code.

verification.method: Five orthographic reference/render overlays using uniform scale and translation, plus two oblique rendered views and independent agent review. Reference imagery remains private. The flare/glazing revision also uses two local owner-photo/render overlays with uniform scale and translation based on body seams, rear body line and gutter. Camera perspective remains unmatched; these overlays are visual checks only.
verification.meaning: Mesh continuity and software scale checks only. They do not establish physical accuracy or a manufacturing tolerance.
verification.remainingDifferences: Fine grille and lamp relief, body contours, suspension mounts, rim brand/profile, tread and sidewall details remain approximate. Actual suspension lift and physical tolerances are unverified.
verification.cabBrow: Compared supplied side/quarter reference pixels and owner passenger photo with actual rendered before/after views and a fixed-registration 50% side overlay. Broadened longitudinal bow recovery and transverse crown blending to remove the artificial inward S curve above the windshield; no dimensional tolerance is inferred.
verification.cabBrowMeshCheck: Eleven longitudinal sections across the rendered roof brow have no inward slope reversal through the transition immediately above the windshield. The central windshield upper-edge elevation remains level.
verification.roofRackAndHood: Actual front, side, oblique, overhead and close-up renders compared with owner photos. Private front hood/light-bar overlays use local scale and translation; no calibrated physical tolerance. Independent reviewer confirmed lowered front crown, legible front mark and seated hood lip; no blocking visual regression. Mobile Chrome emulation at 375 × 844 checked 3D, Front and Top views; desktop rack visibility and roof planning remain operational.

fullSceneGeometry.scope: Default installed scene including roof fan, bagged snowboard, clamps, Owl ladder, carrier and motorcycle; saved editable layout remains separate.

verification.installedRoof: Six actual WebGL views reviewed against owner front, driver, passenger and overhead photos. Uniform-scale roof overlay aligned to the crossbar span; transverse width/perspective mismatch remains, so no physical tolerance is inferred. Independent review corrected panel elevation, removed invented support strips and clarified cell grids. Final review found no blocking visual regression. Exact dimensions, hidden connections and antenna heights remain estimated.
verification.crossbarsAndLadder: Six actual WebGL views and private overhead/driver photo overlays reviewed. Uniform scale and translation retain unresolved perspective/roof-height mismatch. Four exposed main beams plus four partly occluded lower support stations modeled separately; hidden spans inferred. Independent review refined ladder placement 2.5 inches rearward to align its front rail with the glass/flare junction. Finite geometry, seven treads, nominal rear-tire separation and preserved shell length/wheelbase checked. No physical clearance or structural adequacy established.
verification.maxxairAndSnowboard: Six actual WebGL views and a private fixed-rack-span overhead overlay checked. Refined fan placement forward to match the visible rear gap before the panels, and replaced radial cap facets with a smooth grid. Bag uses an irregular soft loft, compressed sections at two rear main crossbars and a flatter overhanging tail. Photo perspective and packing variations remain unresolved; no dimensional tolerance or physical fit established.
verification.cabinLighting: Local geometry/controller tests and desktop/375 × 844 browser interaction checks pass. Private actual WebGL captures reviewed against supplied cockpit renderings and manufacturer layout references. Exact coach interior, swivel mechanism, cassette model, rope routing and photometry remain unverified. Owner approved publication after local review.

sleepingFlares.evidence: Owner photo comparisons in grayscale; approximate camera registered to estimated hub/tire landmarks, without mesh distortion. The side rails end at body Y149 (planning Y123), rear beam at body Y147, and fairing at Y150; all are photo estimates. Intermediate crossbars and sections remain estimates.
